claim_text: Psyllium is a soluble fiber that can increase fiber intake and support bowel regularity in some contexts, but product choice and use require adequate fluid and assessment of swallowing and obstruction risks.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support evidence-based nutrient assessment and avoid automatic supplementation.

population.other_context: People reporting low dietary fiber or digestive regularity goals.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Food and/or supplemental sources; verify exact formulation and label.
evidence_summary: Official psyllium product labeling describes fiber use, fluid requirements and choking warnings.
limitations: No generic dose; follow exact product label and assess dysphagia/obstruction risks.
Exact source passages and clinical applicability require full appraisal.
